item.title: Turkish Admiral's Claims on Libya Maritime Deal Rejected as Baseless by Greece, Egypt, and Cyprus
item.description: Retired Turkish Admiral Cihat Yaycı claims the 2019 Turkey-Libya maritime deal secures 39,000 sq km for Libya and blocks Greek claims to gas-rich zones. Greece, Egypt, and Cyprus reject these assertions, declaring the memorandum illegal under UNCLOS for ignoring the full EEZ rights of Greek islands like Crete.
